name: reddit-easy
description: Post to Reddit with one-time browser login. No Reddit API keys or password fields.
long_description: Reddit Easy uses a dedicated local Helium/Chrome/Edge/Chromium profile. Import it, run reddit_login once, and sign in directly on reddit.com. It reuses that local browser session for posts, comments, edits, deletes, rules, and flair lookups. The plugin has no third-party runtime dependencies, binds browser debugging to loopback only, uses an unpredictable Chrome-assigned debug port, validates Reddit origins, rate-limits writes, blocks recent duplicates, and can erase its local browser session on request.
